assignments.task_summary: Implement the response shape for withdrawn or forbidden sources without disclosing restricted metadata.
Implement one shared unavailable/withdrawn comparison state with an accessible explanation and safe recovery action.
Implement compatibility behavior for the new source visibility status in the runtime decoder.
Independently rebuild the visibility/response decision from written requirements and fresh fixtures.
Implement a bounded result-cache publication rule for duplicate read-only comparison work.
Implement or configure one explicit eviction/retention boundary for the existing comparison cache.
Run a shadow comparison of the old/new visibility query against a bounded shared dataset without changing active reads.
Diagnose and repair one disclosed ordering mechanism in the source-refresh/withdrawal interaction.
Implement a release gate that refuses an older explorer build unable to represent withdrawn sources safely.
Reproduce and repair one disclosed-mechanism incident where the UI candidate and source-generation projection disagree.
Implement or use a minimal request-trace correlation check for the incident without adding sensitive payload logging.
Find a seeded lock-order defect in a disposable two-transaction source-status fixture.
Implement one recovery decision for read-only comparison work interrupted after source loading.
Execute a bounded local restart test for the existing explorer release and its pinned source data.
Run one bounded restore of the existing authorized encrypted snapshot and implement the readiness comparison against a separately retained current source/access-revocation manifest.
Implement and execute a request-accounting check over a bounded degraded explorer workload.
Evaluate the existing read-only assistance path after source withdrawal using a locked candidate and dataset.
Reproduce and repair a seeded private-context cache-key defect without exposing real data.
Rebuild a candidate-lineage manifest from actual artifacts and execute a mismatch checker.
Implement or strengthen one session-expiry recovery test across query, form and local UI state.
Select and exercise one already-built compatible candidate during a source visibility incident.
Inject one controlled dependency slowdown and verify comparison resource containment.
Turn the diagnosed cross-layer incident into one permanent bounded regression and rerun the matching smoke.
Implement a comparison-cache key under a timed fresh prompt and run adversarial equality tests.
Write and execute a latest-per-source-family query with explicit tie-breaking and visibility rules.
Build a small executable state model for pair selection, background refetch and local expansion from a fresh prompt.
Implement a small capacity/failure model comparing on-demand comparison with a stored-derived-result alternative.
Add a fresh existing-payment regression under a new response-loss schedule to test retained system reasoning.
Evaluate two supplied actual-or-explicitly-simulated candidate result sets without changing thresholds after seeing results.
Implement an authorization-generation counterexample model under a fresh interview prompt.
Write a small scenario calculator for the explorer's bounded resource plan without purchasing anything.
Apply one unfamiliar allowed input variation to the existing explorer and trace its behavior through UI, API and SQL.
Find a seeded flaw in a before/after performance comparison and rerun only the corrected bounded experiment.
Turn one opt-in review comment or labeled roleplay objection into an executable explorer usability check.
Implement a checker binding a small set of portfolio claims to actual matching evidence.
Solve one timed fresh Java/SQL integration fault from observations and execute the regression that proves the diagnosis.
Rebuild/restart the exact final candidate in the prepared approved local environment and run a bounded three-case smoke.
Translate a fresh final-checkpoint requirement into an executable counterexample model.
Implement only the filter/cursor seam specified on the previous assessment day.
Author and execute fresh ownership, generation and boundary cases for the learner's final filter implementation.
Diagnose a freshly selected unseen explorer fault from its visible symptoms and safe request/response evidence before editing implementation.
Implement the smallest repair forday363 and compare the correct and defective variants under the same schedule.
Run a timed design/code challenge against the completed change, then test one challenged assumption.
Run only the already prepared final bounded demonstration and resolve the displayed claims to matching evidence.
